android.desc:
There are parallel dimensions to the one you live in. These dimensions make up the latent space, a world only navigable by AI.

Render yourself through dimensions in an Altersnap.

Upload a photo or 5-second video selfie to see yourself in a vortex of parallel dimensions. Download a gif of the whole Altersnap, or pick out your favorite frame and use it as a profile picture.

Install the app and sign in to get started immediately with free Altersnaps – enough to generate hundreds of frames. With in-app purchase, you can render through even more parallel dimensions.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Altersnap – AI profile photos, but y'know, they're you

quotes.text:
tl;dr: Gen-AI images that don’t mess up your face, for fun and profile pics. Also super proud of our stack.

Hi! I’m Wesley/xwes/wesley@alteredlabs.ai. Together with a fellow Xoogler, we’ve been working on our AI stack and this app for the past year. It’s great to finally ship this thing and show it to people!

Record a short selfie video and see each frame in a different time and place. Each frame is processed by AI, and you’re recognizably you (not a long lost cousin) in every frame.

We really like the result. Look at the way

* light in the environment interacts with the face, neck, and shoulders

* collars cast shadows on necks

* light scatters through backlit hair

* there’s no “seam”

It’s inexpensive for you to use and for us to run. Get 10 Altersnaps free (~750 generated images). More via in-app purchase (~450 generated images for $1.50-$2.00). No subscriptions. We make a positive return.

We built Altersnap as a way to show off our stack. We have multiple prototypes running on it, but Altersnap was the one we decided to productionize. The stack is queue-based+containerized+surprisingly plentiful accelerator hardware = horizontally scalable. We’re always looking for new stuff to do with it. Got ideas/questions? Get in touch.

Thanks for checking it out!

App store direct links:

* https://apps.apple.com/app/altersnap/id6449753029

* https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.alteredlabs.altersnap
